# BYZ scope. 国内反对强度 (opposition at home to union with Rome), 0-100 (design 3.2). Read only: not stored and with no
# drift of its own; D2's factions carry it. Framework running: hesychasts + half the rationalists (about 70 at 55/30/15);
# otherwise 60. After 1443, while a union is in force, +5 (the three eastern patriarchs condemned it at Jerusalem).
# 60 and up is high, 40-59 middling, below 40 low.
oe_un_opp = {
    value = 60
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes has_variable = oe_ecc_hes has_variable = oe_ecc_rat }
        value = var:oe_ecc_hes
        add = { value = var:oe_ecc_rat divide = 2 }
    }
    # (phase 2: Mark of Ephesus, oe_un_mark 1 preaching +10, 2 confined +5, 3 lost the disputation -5, until 1450)
    if = { limit = { current_date >= 1443.1.1 oe_un_made = yes } add = 5 }
    min = 0
    max = 100
}
